source_title: AndX Global Unveils Manila One, a First-of-Its-Kind Tokenized Land Development With Global Access
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AndX Global today unveiled Manila One, a $100 million initiative that is the first to tokenize a large-scale, development-stage land project and open it to investors worldwide from day one.
Originated in the Philippines, structured through a U.S.-based investment framework and built for distribution to eligible investors globally, Manila One represents a new model for cross-border real estate investing. It combines a local asset, institutional structuring, global access and a path to liquidity.
Manila One applies tokenization where the most value is created, in the development of raw land, and opens it to investors around the world from the start.
" Tokenization without liquidity is simply digitized illiquidity," said Viru Raparthi, CEO of AndX Global. "Manila One changes that model by giving global investors access at the development stage, while building toward real liquidity. This isn't just about tokenizing real estate. It's about creating a global market for real-world assets."
Manila One is built to overcome the barriers that have kept private real estate closed to most investors: access, currency, minimums and exit.
Global access: open to eligible investors in more than 190 countries, subject to applicable law
USD-denominated: priced and reported in U.S. dollars
Low minimum: tokens priced to ensure maximum participation
Digital ownership: each token represents an economic interest in the development-stage project, with digital custody and blockchain-based recordkeeping
Built for liquidity: designed for secondary trading on regulated AndX exchanges globally, so eligible holders can buy and sell their interests rather than stay locked into a multi-year private investment
Behind the offering is an end-to-end model that AndX intends to apply to other asset classes. It runs from origination through U.S. structuring, digital issuance, global distribution and custody to secondary trading. AndX Global provides the technology, tokenization , exchange, custody, payments and distribution infrastructure.
"The next generation of capital markets won't be defined by geography," Raparthi said. "It will be defined by access."
The asset: 54 hectares, 5 km from Bonifacio Global City
The project centers on about 54 hectares of waterfront land roughly 5 kilometers from Bonifacio Global City (BGC), Metro Manila's leading business district. Proceeds will fund horizontal development, including roads, utilities, drainage and other core infrastructure, to prepare the site for future residential, commercial and mixed-use construction. A later phase is planned to include affordable housing.
Manila One is sponsored by Jack Rodriguez, a Filipino entrepreneur and President of ARC Pacific Development, Inc., whose family story spans generations and two countries. His ancestry traces to passengers associated with the Mayflower and America's earliest Pilgrim settlers, while his own roots remain deeply connected to the Philippines. Rodriguez sees the project as a bridge between the United States and the Philippines.
"Major development opportunities in the Philippines have mostly been available to a small circle of institutions, developers and wealthy families," said Rodriguez. "Manila One opens that up, starting with Filipinos around the world and extending to investors everywhere who want a stake in transforming a major Philippine asset."

Underlying asset: about 54 hectares of waterfront land near BGC, Metro Manila
Indicated land value: more than $200 million, per Cuervo Valuers & Advisory, Inc. (appraisal dated February 3, 2026)
Preferred return: 8% per year, simple and non-compounding (24% over the three-year term)
Additional upside: 100% return on investment tied to appreciation of the underlying land, subject to offering terms
Eligible investors: retail and institutional, in more than 190 countries
Offering documents and eligibility: andx.ai/m1
